'''Reid Wilder''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[July 2000 Austin tournament (29 July)]] on 29 July 2000 with TIE Interceptor Swarm and EBO, according to Justin Warren's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1059">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-30-austin-tx-7-29-00d1059/ austin-tx-7-29-00], DeckTech (Justin "hoostino" Warren, 30 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-30-austin-tx-7-29-00d1059/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
